claim: Nothing about the laser combiner can be read back. Its DAC is write-only; reading back a blanking line returns the writer's own output, not the shutter's state; no combiner monitor signal is wired to any of the DAQ's analog inputs, which float; and the vendor library exports no shutter or status entry point.
validity_conditions: Ruled TRANSFER, passed 10.3 rule 1 (E3, checked in another project on 2026-09-02). It is the evidence behind the device table's read_back false on laser_combiner, stated out loud the way tweez300_reports_nothing_back states it for the trap. The echo point matters most: a digital-output read-back looks like confirmation and is not. The floating-input voltages are prose and are not carried. Slot: A4 (read-back availability) and the orchestrator's verify step, which cannot verify this device. Falsified by any read path that reports a state the software did not write.
